# prismawelt — Iheon Kim (김이헌)

> Personal website of Iheon Kim, a theoretical physics PhD student at POSTECH, and author of essays and criticism on anime, philosophy, memory, and everyday life.

The essays were written in Korean and translated into English and Japanese. Each HTML article contains the full essay and its footnotes. Section links below point directly into that language’s article. The undergraduate thesis is available as an English PDF.

- [Analytic Thermal Bootstrap (undergraduate thesis, PDF)]({{ '/assets/files/bachelor_thesis/Analytic_Thermal_Bootstrap.pdf' | absolute_url }})
